steps.title: Check Trade Eligibility
steps.description: Confirm you meet the Federal Skilled Trades Program requirements and have eligible skilled trade experience.

steps.title: Language Test
steps.description: Complete an approved English or French language test.

steps.title: Proof of Trade Experience
steps.description: Prepare documents demonstrating your skilled trade work experience and qualifications.

steps.title: Create Express Entry Profile
steps.description: Create and submit your Express Entry profile.

steps.title: Receive Invitation to Apply
steps.description: Wait for an Invitation to Apply (ITA) from IRCC.

steps.title: Submit PR Application
steps.description: Submit your permanent residence application with all required supporting documents.

steps.title: Final Review
steps.description: IRCC completes the review of your application before making a final decision.
